name: What is the difference between stucco repair and stucco resurfacing?
description: Stucco repair fixes specific damaged spots, while resurfacing applies a new, uniform layer over the entire existing stucco surface.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between stucco repair and stucco resurfacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stucco repair typically involves fixing specific damaged areas, such as patching holes or filling isolated cracks, to maintain the integrity of the existing finish. Stucco resurfacing, however, is a more comprehensive process where a new layer of stucco is applied over the entire existing surface. This creates a uniform, fresh appearance and can address widespread cosmetic issues. Repair targets localized damage, while resurfacing provides a complete aesthetic overhaul and adds a new protective layer.
